title: The bridge into the city
logline: The bus on a bridge with the city ahead in haze and water below, both invented, drawn from a postcard's edge. The page after the on-ramp in the box; the book prints it before. The sequence's order is the route's, not the drawing's.

panels.composition: From a bus window: a long bridge's railing passing, gray water below, a city's towers ahead in haze, the glass reflecting an empty seat.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from a bus window, a long bridge railing passing with gray water below and a city's towers ahead in haze, the glass reflecting an empty seat, no words
image.notes: Book order: before ro_2023-08-06 (the on-ramp). Box order: after.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
